TC-10/S23.productIssue: Hospital: the summary-failed message ('The reviewed note is saved, but its structured summary needs another attempt. Tap Save Note to retry.') is not announced — no role=alert on the Pre-Round tab or in the editor (oracle: the error is announced, role=alert; NH has it). Nursing Home: the full-screen pre-round editor is not a dialog (no role=dialog, no name), so a screen-reader user is not told a new screen opened (oracle: editor dialog … named). Also NH back button unnamed and contrast failures.
